entries.name: Hyper
entries.content: Hyper is short for hyper-endowed, as in, the character's anatomy (sexual and/or non-sexual) and amount of expelled substance (genital fluids and/or body waste) are unrealistically large, more than can be waved away with artistic license.

entries.name: Inflation
entries.content:
Inflation is the act of pumping or otherwise introducing pressurized air, gas or fluid into an enclosed space in order to expand and increase its volume and size. The act of growing larger as a result of being inflated is expansion. A sexual fetish or paraphilia for these subjects is inflatophilia.

A fetish involving a character, or certain parts of a character, being inflated with air, gasses, water etc. Inflation also includes inflating a balloon.

entries.name: Expansion
entries.content: Expansion is when a character is subjected to having one or multiple parts of their body expanded. May lead to hyper situations if they get out of hand.

entries.name: Cum inflation
entries.content: A specific off-shoot of both the hyper and inflation fetishes, in which a character has had so much cum unloaded inside of them that their body inflates and visibly stretches to accommodate all of it. The resulting expansion can be restricted to a certain part of the body, affect multiple parts, or inflate the entire body at once. In more exaggerated instances, the body might fail to hold the sheer quantity of fluid and start oozing, pouring, or spraying it out of other orifices.

entries.name: Cum Ballooning
entries.content: The more excessive version of cum inflation. Turning whoever, or whatever is receiving cum to the point where their belly (or body) becomes stretched out into a giant, way out of proportion ball.

entries.name: Breast expansion
entries.content:
Expansion focused on a character's breasts where the breasts are described as actively expanding, or implied to have increased in size within a short amount of time, oftentimes with expansion occurring faster than what is physically possible.

If the expansion is not explicitly described in a sequence, it may be conveyed by the character verbally expressing surprise over unexpected growth or remarking on the growing size of them, along with clearly large breasts; this is usually paired with visual clues such as clearly damaged, ill fitting, or ineffective clothing

entries.name: Hyper breasts
entries.content:
Hyper Breasts are breasts that are unrealistically, unbelievably, enormous — far beyond mere exaggeration or artistic license.
Hyper breasts should be many times larger than their owner's head. If the breasts are only slightly larger than, or equal to the size of the head, they should not be classified as hyper breasts. Hyper breasts should cover most or all of the character's upper body, possibly sagging to their crotch or thighs. 'Smaller' hyper breasts are frequently unrealistically perky and round, allowing the midriff to be visible. Hyper breasts should at least extend down beyond the waist or crotch when naturally hanging.

entries.name: Hyper thighs
entries.content:
Hyper thighs describes characters with truly massive thighs, which are disproportionate to the rest of the character's body.

An individual thigh on the character should be at least twice the width/diameter as the character's waist to fall under hyper thighs. If the character's thighs are very large, but proportionate and/or less than twice the width of the character's waist.

A character with hyper thighs is practically always going to have a set of equally hyper hips and may also be hyper in other ways. Morbidly obese characters may have hyper thighs, but their size makes them less disproportionate. Alternatively, a character may have a fairly normal body outside of their extremely large thighs.

entries.name: Hyper butt
entries.content: Hyper Butt describes "impossibly massive" buttocks which are disproportionately sized to the rest of the character's body

entries.name: Hyper pregnancy
entries.content:
Pregnancies which involve an unrealistic amount of offspring, and/or an extremely large belly.

Depictions of (implied, or explicit) octotuplet or nonuplet pregnancy (which may occur in real life, although they are extremely rare), can be set as a "lower limit" on what counts as a hyper-sized pregnancy, however, a character may have fewer offspring and a far larger pregnant belly than what 3-6 babies may entail in reality. A hyper pregnancy could also involve a single extremely large fetus within the womb.

entries.name: Futanari
entries.content: Futanari is when a character shows primary sexual characteristics from both females and males. It refers almost exclusively to characters who have a female or overall feminine body, but have both female and male primary genitalia. A scrotum is not always present, while breasts, a penis, and a vulva are.

entries.name: Feederism
entries.content: Feederism involves a character being fed, or encouraged to eat, large amounts of food in order to gain weight.

entries.name: Femboy
entries.content: A male-bodied character with a feminine presentation in regard to personality, clothing, and/or body type.
